item.title: Deutsche Börse Readiness Newsflash | T7 Release 15.0: Readiness Statement is available
item.description:
With this Newsflash we would like to inform you about the publication of the Readiness Statement for T7 Release 15.0. All Trading Participants, Registered Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) and Third Party Information Providers (TPIPs) are requested to submit the Readiness Statement by Friday, 30 October 2026 at the latest.
The Readiness Statement can be found here Readiness Statement​.
For the submission, the dedicated Trading PIN is required. The PIN is available via the Member Section, accessible to Central Coordinators and their Deputies only, under the following path:
Member Section > My Profile > PIN.
We kindly remind you to participate in the simulation environment and the connection test to ensure a smooth transition. Your participation is crucial for a successful implementation.
All information about T7 Release 15.0 can be found on the Deutsche Börse website www.cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com under the following link: T7 Release 15.0.
If you have any further questions or comments, please do not hesitate to send an e-mail to: client.services@deutsche-boerse.com.

item.title: Amendments to the GTC to the Connection Agreement and to the Provider Connection Agreement of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, as well as to the Price List for the Utilization of the Exchange EDP of FWB Frankfurt Stock Exchange, effective as of 9 November 2026
item.description:
1. Introduction
With this circular, we inform you about amendments to the GTC to the Connection Agreement and to the Provider Connection Agreement of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, as well as about amendments to the Price List for the Utilization of the Exchange EDP of FWB Frankfurt Stock Exchange, Part A (Price List T7), effective as of 9 November 2026.
The changes to the GTC to the Connection Agreement and to the Provider Connection Agreement of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange relate to the introduction of Sponsored Access (SpA).
The changes to the Price List T7 relate to the following:
A. Introduction of Sponsored Access (SpA)
B. Introduction of a 1Gbit/s transaction line
2. Requirements for participation
We kindly ask FWB Trading Participants to review their use of the new services.
3. Details of the initiative
Changes to the GTC to the Connection Agreement and to the Provider Connection Agreement of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange
In preparation for the introduction of Sponsored Access (SpA) at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange planned for 1 February 2027, the following amendments will be made to the GTC to the Connection Agreement and to the Provider Connection Agreement:
Definition of the terms “SpA Provider”, “SpA User”, “DMA Provider” and “DMA User”, and
Clarification of the provisions governing the rights and obligations of SpA Providers and DMA Providers.
In addition, the liability provisions will be adjusted.
Changes to the T7 Price List
A. Introduction of Sponsored Access (SpA)
For the utilization of Sponsored Access, new connectivity components (bandwidths and sessions) are offered. The new Sponsored Access connectivity components for FWB Trading Participants acting as SpA Providers and for Multi-Member Service Providers are included in the T7 Price List. Until the launch of Sponsored Access, planned for 1 February 2027, fees for Sponsored Access connectivity components are waived.
B. Introduction of a 1 Gbit/s transaction line
With T7 Release 15.0, Deutsche Börse AG introduces the 1 Gbit/s transaction line “Transactions ETI 1 Gbit/s Prime”. The price for this connectivity item is included in the T7 Price List.
Further information on the planned introduction of Sponsored Access
The Connection Agreement for SpA Users, the corresponding GTC to the Connection Agreement for SpA Users and the Price List to the Connection Agreement for SpA Users will be provided shortly.
The introduction of SpA is still subject to the approval of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange Council and the Hessian Stock Exchange Supervisory Authority.
The amendments will be deemed to be approved, unless the Trading Participant admitted at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange or Vendor files objections to the amendments with Deutsche Börse AG, Mergenthalerallee 61, 65760 Eschborn, Germany, in writing within six weeks after the amendments’ announcement.
Attachments:
1 – Amended sections of the “General Terms and Conditions of the Agreement on the Utilization of the Exchange EDP of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Connection Agreement)”, effective as of 9 November 2026 2 – Amended sections of the “General Terms and Conditions to the Agreement on technical connection of a Multi-Member Service Provider to the Exchange-EDP of Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse (Provider Connection Agreement)”, effective as of 9 November 2026 3 – Amended sections of the Price List for the Utilization of the Exchange EDP of FWB Frankfurt Stock Exchange, Part A (Price List T7), effective as of 9 November 2026

item.title: Deutsche Börse Cash Market T7 Infrastructure: Improved cable-length normalization of Deutsche Börse Colo 2.0 10 Gbit/s participant connections in the Equinix FR2 co-location facility
item.description:
1. Introduction
Deutsche Börse will further improve cable-length normalization for Colo 2.0 10 Gbit/s participant connections in the Equinix FR2 co-location facility. This initiative is attended to further reduce differences in the physical length of participant connections and to provide even more consistent technical conditions across the Colo 2.0 infrastructure.
As a first step, a limited validation will be performed on selected Deutsche Börse Order Entry connections in Q4 2026.
Based on the current planning, the cable-length adjustment for Deutsche Börse Order Entry and Market Data connections is scheduled for Q3 2027. The activities will be performed during announced maintenance windows.
Affected connections will be temporarily interrupted during the respective maintenance activity. Detailed dates, affected services, and participant testing windows will be communicated in advance via Implementation News.
2. Required action
No changes to participant trading applications or network configurations are required.
Participants whose connections are included in a maintenance activity will be asked to verify connectivity during the testing window specified in the respective Implementation News.
The planned checks may include verifying connectivity to the Connection Gateways and the receipt of technical heartbeat messages. Dedicated technical support will be available during the announced testing windows.
3. Details of the initiative
Deutsche Börse is currently performing infrastructure preparation and measurement activities across the Colo 2.0 environment. These activities are a prerequisite for the planned cable -length adjustment of participant connections, and the resulting measurements will be used to determine the required adjustments for individual connections.
Before the broader adjustment of Deutsche Börse participant connections, a limited single-weekend validation will be performed on selected Deutsche Börse Order Entry connections in Q4 2026. The validation will be used to confirm the cable-length adjustment approach under controlled conditions.
Following completion and review of the validation, the cable-length adjustment for Deutsche Börse Order Entry and Market Data connections is currently planned for Q3 2027. The activities will be carried out during announced maintenance windows.

The limited validation on selected Deutsche Börse Order Entry connections is currently planned for Q4 2026.
The cable length adjustment of Deutsche Börse Order Entry and Market Data connections is currently planned for Q3 2027.
The effective date for each affected connection will be the maintenance date announced in the corresponding Implementation News. Participants will receive advance information about the affected service, infrastructure side, maintenance window and connectivity testing window.
